"There are about 190 currencies around the world. My view is that in 10-20 years from now, those 190 will be 10.

I think the US stablecoins ultimately will be the big savior or one of the biggest saviors of the US dollar, because it democratizes access to the US dollar.

In the drawdown from last year’s highs, SUI fell about 80%, SOL about 70%, ETH about 60%. Brutal.

But the charts missed what was underneath. On all three, economic density didn’t move. Users left, as they always do in a bear market, but the capital each remaining user had deployed stayed exactly where it was... the tourists and the bots went, and the people who stayed kept doing what they’d been doing.

I spent a lot of time measuring this: stablecoin float, DeFi TVL and applications shipped per daily user, across every major L1. Why? Because I think it’s the truest measure of longevity there is.

Every other L1 I measured lost density along with price. Adoption hadn’t taken hold yet. Doesn’t mean it won’t, but it hasn’t...

i wanted a physical version of my ai agent. Something real in the living room that shows my to-do list and my day, and that my wife can see too.

I bought a seeed reterminal e1002, an e-ink display. e-ink because it looks like paper: no glow, no buzz, it just sits there like a note on the wall (almost)

setup was honestly simple:
- built the open-source muse gadget firmware on my computer with my sdk token in it
- flashed it to the device over usb
- paired it in the muse app (settings, devices, developer mode) thanks @natfriedman 

now every morning at 7am my agent renders my briefing (calendar, top to-dos, weather) and pushes it to the screen. my wife reads it over coffee. it basically became the family's shared to-do list

whole thing took ~20 min. your agent doesn't have to live in a chat window. give it a physical representation!
